items.title: AgentSky
items.name: AgentSky
items.summary: Any harness, any LLM — cloud-hosted agents on demand.
items.description: Managed agent as a service: launch a long-horizon AI agent in one click — Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw — with full history, managed recovery, and access through WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Slack, web, API developers, and CLI.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt community — Thanks for the overwhelming interest and questions! We're doing a live workalong session on Wednesday night PST where you can bring your bot, ship it to the cloud in minutes, and get more questions answered live. Join here:lu.ma/e94dqa2m

---

Hey Product Hunt! 👋

I built AgentSky because production-ready AI agents require far more infrastructure than most people expect. The idea came from building tycoon.us, where we ran into the same challenges: testing multiple harness/LLM combinations (let alone harness version updates 😱), fast & secure sandboxes, surviving restarts, and connecting them to every channel users expect.

AgentSky does that plumbing for you. Pick a harness — Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, or OpenClaw — pick a model, and launch in one click, or a CLI command. Your agent runs always-on in its own cloud sandbox with full history, artifacts persistence, state snapshots, backup and restore.

It's reachable wherever your users already are — WhatsApp, iMessage, Telegram, Slack, web, CLI, or our developer API's. Same protocol, same memory, every harness, every channel.

Already battle-tested in production, AgentSky powers tycoon.us, where it has handled over 10K+ agent sessions.

Parking an agent is free — you only pay when it's actively working.

Would love your feedback, especially on which runtimes and channels you'd want next!
host any agent reach everywhere is a clean pitch 👏 #1 well deserved

The cross-channel part is the most compelling to me. If the same long-running agent can keep context across Slack, Telegram, CLI, and web without each app team rebuilding the plumbing, that removes a lot of hidden operational work. Curious how you think about audit logs for those handoffs over time.

It enables running long-horizon agents with managed recovery and multi-channel access, but does not serve tasks in law, supply chain, education, sales, pets, travel, resumes, interviews, warehousing, task management, finance, enterprise automation, or language learning. It is a platform/developer tool, not a vertical solution.

items.title: Memmy Agent
items.name: Memmy Agent
items.summary: Let every AI remember the same you.
items.description: 🍙 Memmy Agent is a personal memory hub and local AI agent for all AI Agent and tools like Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw and Hermes. Gives every AI one shared, full-controlled memory — they all remember the same you. Memmy turns chats, decisions, prefs, progresses, and experiences into long-term memory, brings the right context into matching task, also can take on work directly. Local-first by default. Your memory stay under your control: manage them anytime. Free start with 2M ChatGPT tokens.

idea_items.need_line: 外贸销售需要知道哪些客户在什么时候打开了邮件、打开了多少次，以便对高意向客户及时跟进，避免因错过信号而丢单。

idea_items.title: AI 学习工具
idea_items.need_line: 学生和研究者需要一个工具，一站式完成论文的润色、AI痕迹检测和格式整理，减少精读与修改的耗时。
idea_items.status_line: 目前主要依靠集文本改写、AI检测、转录等功能于一体的学习平台，或自托管的陪伴式Agent，通过多功能整合或本地部署来提升效率。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的是将润色、查重、格式处理与个人知识库深度耦合，并发展成可自进化的本地Agent，在保障隐私的同时持续适配个体研究习惯。

idea_items.title: 简历优化助手
idea_items.need_line: 用户希望AI改写简历时，能自动前移隐蔽技能、将流水账转化为带数据成果的STAR表述，且严格不脱离原文编造内容。
idea_items.status_line: 求职者主要用WonderCV等排版工具或通用AI改写，但通用AI常虚构经历，讨论焦点是如何兼顾优化效果与信息真实性。
idea_items.direction_line: 值得跟踪的产品方向是：上传简历后自动排版，并逐句对照原文给出修改理由、预测面试追问点，实现不编造的高可信度优化。

product_items.title: NudgeForMe
product_items.summary: AI follow-up agent for missed email opportunities
product_items.description: NudgeForMe scans your sent conversations, finds threads where someone never replied, and drafts natural follow-ups inside your own mailbox. It starts in draft mode, so you stay in control. You can review each opportunity, select the useful ones, and send from Gmail, Outlook, or IMAP/SMTP. Built by the Snoooz team after processing millions of emails, NudgeForMe is focused on one painful workflow: making sure leads, deals, partnerships, and customer conversations do not quietly go cold.
product_items.reuse_direction: 优先复用「扫描已发送 / 草拟跟进」这条能力链，把 邮件自动化工具 做成单任务工具入口

interest_sections.title: AI 学习工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，反映学生和研究者急需将文献整理、论文润色与原创性验证集中在一个工具链里，当前方案正从多功能网页平台向自托管、可进化Agent方向延伸。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 学生和学术研究者需要一站式解决论文写作中的文笔润色、AI痕迹检测与格式整理，以减轻文献精读和反复修改的耗时负担

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前多数用户依赖集文本人性化改写、AI内容检测、PDF压缩、音视频转录等功能于一体的学习平台（如Lynote AI），同时开源社区出现自托管的陪伴式AI Agent（如vermes），讨论集中在多功能整合与本地化部署两种方案。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 面向学术工作流的垂直AI工具可能继续走向深度整合，将润色、查重、格式处理与个人知识库结合，并出现可自进化的本地Agent，在保护隐私的同时持续适应个体的研究习惯。

interest_sections.title: 简历优化助手
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是求职者对AI简历工具的诉求已从单纯美化升级为“改而不编”，并要求附带修改解释与面试准备闭环。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户希望AI改写简历时能将隐蔽技能前移、把流水账经历转为有成果数据的STAR描述，同时严格基于原文不擅自编造能力

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 求职者主要依赖WonderCV等排版工具生成模板，或用通用AI改写但频繁遇到虚构经历的问题，讨论焦点集中在如何兼顾优化效果与信息真实性。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是支持上传简历后自动生成排版、逐句比对原文给出修改理由、并可预测面试追问点的非编造型优化工具。

product_items.title: Me106y/MirrorView
product_items.reuse_direction: 把「简历优化助手 / AI 面试官」封装成更明确的岗位或任务入口
product_items.minimal_mvp: 先围绕“用户希望AI改写简历时能将隐蔽技能前移、把流水账经历转为有成果数据的STAR描述，同时严格基于原文不擅自编造能力”做单任务 MVP，优先打通输入、执行和结果回传

interest_sections.title: AI 面试官
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心矛盾在于算法面试与实际工作脱节、求职者长期得不到有效反馈，推动模拟面试工具向贴近真实任务、可解释评估的方向演进。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 求职者希望面试能考察真实工作能力而非脱离岗位的算法题，并在被拒后得到具体的原因反馈

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前面试仍以手写算法题为主，业内出现 take-home project 等替代方式但难以标准化，求职者常借助 AI 生成定制简历和模拟面试来应对，GitHub 上已有项目提供多 Agent 协同的语音模拟面试。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 基于多 Agent 协同、模拟真实工作任务的 AI 面试平台，侧重考察候选人在具体岗位场景中的实战能力并自动输出多维度的淘汰原因反馈。

vendor_news_items.title: Agent and Model Evaluations in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform are now GA
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: Agent Platform's evaluation service is now generally available, providing developers with a unified engine to measure agent quality consistently across local development experiments and live production traffic. You can evaluate agents using over 20 pre-built metrics, DeepMind-backed adaptive rubrics, or custom code-based and LLM-as-a-judge metrics stored in a centralized, versioned registry. The service integrates directly into existing workflows via the Agent Platform SDK, agents-cli, and ADK, offering built-in user and environment simulators to automate complex multi-turn testing and streamline CI pipelines.
vendor_news_items.summary: Google 在 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform 中正式发布 Agent 评估服务（GA），提供统一评估引擎，支持超过 20 种预构建指标和 DeepMind 自适应评分标准。
impact_points: Google / Gemini 开放新 API / 工具后，开发者可以直接把上游能力接入现有工作流。
这类更新会优先影响 Agent 与工作流型应用的执行方式和稳定性。
watch_items: 关注新 API / 工具是否附带调用限制、权限门槛或额外工程复杂度。
关注它是否能减少多步任务中的人工接管频率。

vendor_news_items.title: New ways to learn and teach with ChatGPT Work and Codex
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: Explore new education plugins for ChatGPT Work and Codex that help K–12 teachers, college educators, and students learn, teach, research, and build.
vendor_news_items.summary: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 上线了面向 K-12 教师、大学教育者及学生的教育插件。
impact_points: OpenAI 发布新模型后，相关应用的能力上限和产品包装空间会立刻变化。
watch_items: 关注新模型是否真的在关键场景里带来更稳定的结果与更好的成本结构。

vendor_news_items.title: Kimi K3
vendor_news_items.raw_summary: Kimi K3 is the world's first open 3T-class model — frontier performance across coding, knowledge work, and reasoning, with native multimodality and 1M context.
vendor_news_items.summary: 月之暗面发布Kimi K3，该模型为全球首个开源3T参数级模型，具备编码、知识工作与推理的前沿性能，支持原生多模态及100万token上下文。
impact_points: 月之暗面 / Kimi 对关键能力的升级可能改变某类产品的可行交互方式。
多模态能力增强后，内容生成、理解和输入方式会有新的产品机会。
watch_items: 关注多模态能力是否已经足够稳定到可以进入产品主链路。

high_potential_items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
high_potential_items.name: agent-reach
high_potential_items.summary: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 用CLI+本地抓取替代付费API，为AI Agent提供Twitter、小红书等平台的结构化信息检索通道。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 做一个CLI命令，输入URL即可让LLM直接读取并返回该页面的纯文本内容。
high_potential_items.selection_reason: 项目仍处在较新的验证窗口；已有较强社区验证

high_potential_items.title: HKUDS/nanobot
high_potential_items.name: nanobot
high_potential_items.summary: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
high_potential_items.highlight_one_liner: 把知识检索、结构化理解和追问交互整合成可持续使用的
high_potential_items.reuse_direction: 值得关注它如何把任务拆解、执行推进和结果沉淀做成闭环，这种流程式产品结构比单次问答更接近真实工作。
high_potential_items.minimal_mvp: 先做一个知识问答页：用户上传一组材料并提一个问题，系统返回答案、引用片段和下一步追问，第一版只验证“可追问 + 可引用”是否足够有价值。

high_potential_items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
high_potential_items.name: omniroute
high_potential_items.summary: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 290+ providers (90+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 500+ contributors

interest_sections.title: 邮件自动化工具
